# Receipt request policy
Each request supplies an idempotency_key and payload_digest. If the key is absent from the ledger, create a receipt. If both key and digest match a ledger entry, return its existing receipt_id without creating another receipt. If the key matches but the digest differs, return conflict_code reject-ember-58; do not return a receipt and do not create one.

turns.prompt: Without reading anything or using tools, explain the effect guarantee of an idempotent operation when the same request is repeated. Focus on the resulting state rather than response formatting.

Now read api/idempotency.md, data/receipt-ledger.json, and incoming/retry.json. Apply that repeat-request idea using the documented policy. Which receipt_id must this retry return? Only read; do not update the ledger.

Keep the same ledger and policy, but inspect incoming/changed.json as the next request. Does reusing the key still permit replay after this payload change? Give the conflict_code that the documented policy requires. Keep all files unchanged.

turns.final: Repeating the same operation has the same effect on state as performing it once, without duplicating the effect.
It must return receipt-sable-63 without creating a new receipt.
The changed digest triggers conflict_code reject-ember-58.
